---
title: AI Query
---

Send a text query or sample image to Gemini and show the result in a spatial
card. Choose **Ask about WebXR** or **Describe sample** and inspect the pending,
response, or failure state.

The optional API-key prompt is for a local prototype and keeps the key for the
current page session. Production requests need server-controlled credentials.
See [provider setup](/integrations/ai-providers).

[AI queries](/sdk/ai) · [Example catalog](/examples)
